pkgmetadata.longdescription: Installs a networkd-dispatcher "routable" hook that runs 'net ads dns register --machine-pass' whenever a network interface becomes routable. Samba Active Directory domain members do not periodically refresh their own DNS records the way Windows clients do (records are only created at join time), so member A/AAAA records can go missing or stale. This hook restores netlogon-like behaviour by re-registering the host in the authoritative Samba AD DNS zone on initial address assignment and on IP changes. Behaviour is tunable via /etc/conf.d/samba-ad-dns-register (enable/disable, interface allow-list, net binary path, extra register arguments).
